name: Climb and descend
description: Change height without turning a gentle descent into a fall.

steps.text: Start in Angle mode. Add a little throttle to climb; reduce it slightly to descend. Keep room to stop.
steps.title: Plan a controlled climb

steps.text: Hold the lower marker with gentle corrections.
steps.title: Settle at the lower marker

steps.text: Climb to the upper marker. Reduce throttle early enough to stop the climb.
steps.title: Climb and stop

steps.text: Descend to the lower marker. Add throttle before reaching it to slow the descent.
steps.title: Descend and stop

steps.text: Return to the start marker. Level the drone, lower throttle gently and hold a stopped landing for two seconds.
steps.title: Land at the start
